# Paul Lewis

> Paul Lewis is a fullstack engineer and product designer based in New York City. paullew.is is his personal site and the best place to find his contact details and profiles.

He studied computer science at the University of Pittsburgh, with minors in music and Spanish. He speaks English and Spanish fluently and French conversationally, and runs a homelab in his spare time.

## Skills

- Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Vite, Electron, Blazor, HTML, CSS
- Backend: C#, .NET, Python, Node, Express, FastAPI, GraphQL, REST APIs, SQL, Postgres
- Infrastructure: Docker, Linux, CI/CD, Proxmox, Tailscale, Caddy, DNS, TLS
- Testing: pytest, NUnit, Playwright, Vitest
